headlines.title: Steelers and Bengals meet again with the AFC North on the line
headlines.summary: Pittsburgh and Cincinnati meet in Week 10 for a rematch with real division stakes. The Steelers won the first game 30–27 in September, stopping a late Bengals bid with a defensive stand. Joe Burrow completed 28 of 37 passes for 282 yards and three touchdowns in that game, coming closer than anyone this season to solving Pittsburgh's soft zone. Chase Brown has also hurt the Steelers in recent meetings. The game is on Sunday Night Football.
headlines.whyItMatters: Both teams are 6–2 and among the AFC's top six seeds. The winner takes a one-game lead, and if it's Pittsburgh they will own the head-to-head tiebreaker.

headlines.title: Ravens lean on Brissett with Lamar Jackson out
headlines.summary: Lamar Jackson is out after right thumb surgery, so Jacoby Brissett is running the Baltimore offence. The Ravens are 4–5 and 1.0 games behind the last AFC playoff spot. They play the Chargers on Monday night, and Ladd McConkey is listed as questionable for the Chargers.
headlines.whyItMatters: Baltimore need to stay in the wild-card race while their starter is out, and Monday night's game is the next test.

headlines.title: Eagles hold Dallas Goedert after deadline flurry
headlines.summary: The Eagles traded Jordan Davis and centre Cam Jurgens before the deadline but kept tight end Dallas Goedert, who was wanted by several teams including the 49ers. Goedert, 31, could re-sign with Philadelphia for 2027. The Eagles are 2–7 and have lost seven straight, so the deadline moves signal a rebuild.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia are 16th in the NFC, and the moves set up a rebuild rather than a playoff push this season.

headlines.title: Patriots put Henderson on IR and get two players back
headlines.summary: New England placed running back TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve after an unexplained neurological illness that began in late October. Henderson says tests have been 'positive and reassuring', but the cause is still unknown, and he will miss at least four games. The Patriots activated fullback Reggie Gilliam and offensive lineman Greg Van Roten. Starter Rhamondre Stevenson is managing a knee tendon injury.
headlines.whyItMatters: New England are 5–4 and seventh in the AFC, and their running back depth is now thin.

teamNews.title: Mendoza makes his first start for the Raiders
teamNews.text: Rookie Fernando Mendoza starts at quarterback against the Seahawks on Sunday, the first start of his career. Head coach Klint Kubiak expects him to lead the offence and says the team will give him a lot of reps. The Raiders traded Kirk Cousins to the Vikings for a 2027 third-round pick.

contextCard.title: How NFL fines work
contextCard.body: Players can be fined for on-field conduct such as unnecessary roughness, illegal use of the helmet or unsportsmanlike conduct, even when no flag is thrown. The amounts follow a schedule set by the league and are usually announced in the days after the game. The league says the money it collects goes to player-related causes.

nba.oneThing: The Spurs made it 11 straight wins with a 123–85 rout of the Warriors, a night Golden State played without Stephen Curry.

headlines.title: Lakers level with the Spurs at the top, but they want to get better
headlines.summary: The Lakers are 11–2, tied with the Spurs for the league's best record, and have won seven straight. Coaches used a rare break to show players slide presentations on offensive and defensive flaws. JJ Redick wants the Lakers to become a top-10 defence, with rebounding and turnovers as the main concerns. Austin Reaves is out for Sunday's game at Phoenix with a left heel bruise, and Redick says he is day-to-day.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers play three games in four days after Sunday, so Reaves' heel will test their depth.

headlines.title: Embiid out again as the Sixers face the Pacers
headlines.summary: Joel Embiid is out for Sunday's game against Indiana with right plantar fascia management. Adem Bona (cervical spine sprain) and Dominick Barlow (back) are also out, and Barlow has no timeline to return. LeBron James is not on the injury report after missing a Thursday win with sciatica. Tacko Fall is the only active centre on the roster.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia are 10–3 and second in the East, but the frontcourt is thin for a back-to-back that continues in Brooklyn on Monday.

headlines.title: Knicks' title defence has an uneven start
headlines.summary: Josh Hart says he is 'not in a good headspace' as the Knicks struggle to find form in their title defence. They are 6–6 and sixth in the East after losing two straight, the latest 106–104 at Indiana. Jalen Brunson had 33 points and 11 assists in that game, and Karl-Anthony Towns had 23 points and 15 rebounds.
headlines.whyItMatters: New York sit in a tightly bunched middle of the East, so a slow start leaves little room for error.

headlines.title: Suns make Jalen Green available in trade
headlines.summary: The Suns have made Jalen Green available, according to RealGM, and are reportedly in the market for a point guard. Green and Devin Booker are both guards, and neither is a point guard. Green is owed $36.2 million this season, followed by a $36 million player option. Phoenix are 5–6 and struggling to compete around the basket, according to Yahoo Sports.

recaps.keyLine: Cryer 20 pts, 2 reb, 6 ast, 6 3PM · Bassey 11 pts, 5 reb, 2 ast · Castle 32 pts, 5 reb, 6 ast, 5 3PM · Johnson 18 pts, 4 reb, 4 ast
recaps.text: The Spurs opened on an 18–0 run and never let the Warriors into the game, winning 123–85 for their 11th straight. Stephon Castle's 32 points were a season high, and Victor Wembanyama added 12 rebounds and six assists. Golden State were without Stephen Curry, and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg, stepping into the lead scoring role, shot 1-of-13 and said he was flustered.

recaps.keyLine: Gilgeous-Alexander 40 pts, 4 reb, 5 ast · McCain 23 pts, 4 reb, 2 ast, 7 3PM · Lopez 26 pts, 7 reb, 4 ast · Garland 24 pts, 4 reb, 7 ast
recaps.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40, but the Clippers won by one point at home in one of the season's bigger upsets. Brook Lopez had 26 points and Darius Garland had 24 points and seven assists to carry the home side. Jared McCain's seven threes kept Oklahoma City in it until the end.

recaps.keyLine: Johnson 27 pts, 11 reb, 10 ast · McCollum 20 pts, 5 reb, 5 ast · Powell 33 pts, 5 reb, 2 ast · Giddey 15 pts, 10 reb, 14 ast, 3 blk
recaps.text: Chicago beat Atlanta 125–117 in overtime, with Norman Powell scoring 33 for the Bulls. Josh Giddey had 15 points, 10 rebounds, 14 assists and three blocks, a triple-double that was the difference. Jalen Johnson's 27 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists weren't enough to get the Hawks home.

recaps.keyLine: Brunson 33 pts, 1 reb, 11 ast · Towns 23 pts, 15 reb, 5 ast, 3 stl · Siakam 19 pts, 3 reb, 2 ast · Nesmith 18 pts, 7 reb, 1 ast
recaps.text: Indiana held on for a 106–104 win over New York. Jalen Brunson scored 33 with 11 assists, and Karl-Anthony Towns added 23 points and 15 rebounds, but the Knicks couldn't make the decisive stop. The loss adds to their uneven start.

recaps.keyLine: Mitchell 25 pts, 4 reb, 7 ast, 5 3PM · Proctor 22 pts, 4 reb, 3 ast, 5 3PM · Adebayo 37 pts, 14 reb, 3 ast · Antetokounmpo 37 pts, 9 reb, 2 ast
recaps.text: Miami beat Cleveland 133–121 behind 37-point games from Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Davion Mitchell's 17 assists were the other big number, and the win is the Heat's sixth in their last eight games.
